Polymath Horizon-SWE

cohort4.benchmark.horizon-swe

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Actual complete pinned creator methodological article read establishes one named Horizon-SWE benchmark with50task workflows, production-derived code/synthetic traffic and feature/deployment checks. PFexcludes subjective engineering-quality judgment; PCuses60/30/10weights. These are two scoring views of one family. The original three exact qualified observations have separate author/source-verifier/adversarial content receipts. Private tasks/full harness/judge calibration/rights remain unknown. Full_source denotes available primary methods/results/limits content, not unavailable proprietary corpus, license audit, experiment reproduction or production-effectiveness proof.

Polymath Horizon-SWE · documents: The creator distinguishes Horizon-SWE-PF (pass/fail), requiring complete feature and deployment checks, from Horizon-SWE-PC (partial credit), weighted 60% feature correctness, 30% deployment/DevOps and 10% engineering quality.

  • The weighted partial-credit score and strict solved rate are different views of one family; LLM engineering-quality judgment is excluded from the strict solved metric.
